raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Tune gfx950 MXFP8 linear tiles for MiniMax-M3.1 decode and small prefill batches (`16 < M <= 256`, local `N > 1280`). Keep the main configuration for TP2 QKV at `128 < M <= 192`, where the tuned tile regresses.

## Claims

- Tile-only change; reuse the existing Triton GEMM and preserve the fallback outside the tuned range.
- One mid-M table owns the overlapping gfx950 `17 <= M <= 64`, `N > 1280` range with #64195; integrate that overlap here rather than stacking selectors. This PR also tunes M65–256; #64195's additional small-N coverage is outside its scope.
- Keep the measured M48 MiniMax TP4 QKV tile in the table. Remove the V4.1-specific N=1792 bucket; normal V4.1 serving uses the separate block-scaled GEMM.

## Validation

### MiniMax-M3.1 GEMMs: main `ffdf26702` vs `4bfce4e2e`

MI355X, same image and inputs; 36 cases covering all six TP4/TP2 shapes at M48/64/96/128/192/256. **The 34 changed tiles reduce GEMM latency by 4.64–58.15%.** M48 TP4 QKV keeps its main tile. TP2 QKV now also keeps the main tile for `128 < M <= 192`.

The initial M192 TP2 QKV measurement regressed **23.296 → 26.608 µs (+14.22%)**. That shape/range is excluded from the tuned path; M128/129/160/192/193 boundary checks confirm the intended dispatch. The other measured buckets are retained.

<details>
<summary>All 36 GEMM timings and measurement method</summary>

Values are **main → PR, µs/GEMM**; these are kernel timings.

| Linear (N, K) | M48 | M64 | M96 | M128 | M192 | M256 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| TP4 QKV (2560, 6144) | 10.903 → 10.888 | 17.566 → 11.468 | 19.979 → 13.728 | 20.162 → 13.798 | 20.453 → 18.515 | 20.534 → 18.824 |
| TP4 output (6144, 2048) | 12.495 → 6.243 | 13.992 → 6.334 | 9.148 → 8.724 | 9.300 → 8.764 | 16.743 → 12.705 | 16.841 → 13.096 |
| TP4 shared gate/up (1536, 6144) | 9.379 → 7.353 | 9.961 → 7.501 | 16.243 → 11.439 | 17.960 → 11.546 | 20.216 → 13.649 | 20.044 → 13.782 |
| TP4 shared down (6144, 768) | 4.914 → 3.992 | 5.215 → 4.122 | 4.974 → 4.549 | 5.074 → 4.668 | 6.833 → 6.263 | 6.956 → 6.498 |
| TP2 QKV (4992, 6144) | 19.526 → 14.003 | 26.550 → 14.136 | 20.795 → 19.558 | 21.030 → 19.582 | 22.902 → 22.890 | 41.073 → 35.953 |
| TP2 dense gate/up (12288, 6144) | 42.104 → 22.029 | 53.383 → 22.342 | 42.124 → 36.388 | 42.721 → 39.517 | 62.752 → 59.103 | 67.605 → 62.010 |

Prequantized E4M3 activations/weights with E8M0 scales and BF16 output, seed 4671. Each graph rotates `ceil(512 MiB / (N*K*33/32))` weight copies. Seven alternating rounds, 40 graph replays per round; report the median device-event time per GEMM. Quantization is outside the timed region.

Runtime: `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm@sha256:9cef62361792bd9cc621725c3af799993b6a68b6b62e3778dcf9b65ff6fcd872`. The image's baseline native GEMM source is byte-identical to main `ffdf26702`; the candidate source and tests match [4bfce4e2e](https://github.com/jiacao-amd/vllm/commit/4bfce4e2e8e9055e00e5b3e43933a4ee341df4f1).

</details>

Revalidated the final source on MI355X: **296 kernel tests passed, 0 skipped; six two-stream graph checks passed**. Pre-commit passed.

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/kernels/quantization/test_rocm_mxfp8_linear.py
```

### 900 s AgentX: main `380c8e438` vs tiles only

4× MI355X, TP4, AgentX 1.0.12; **900 s per arm** after warmup. Model: `amd/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Quark-MXFP4` at `0a00e0e39fc00499b23efccc18a8ea63fce5c44c`. [InferenceX #4671](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4671) at `bed892b82`, DSpark K7, synthetic AL 4.04, seed 42.

Values are baseline → candidate. p90 interactivity uses `output_token_throughput_per_user.p10`; total throughput includes cached input tokens.

Candidate: [99ec093d5](https://github.com/jiacao-amd/vllm/commit/99ec093d52c1b094eb9d543a01fd5c032b3e0bcc). One pair per concurrency; norm+quant fusion is already in the baseline.

| Comparison | p90 interactivity (tok/s/user) | Output tok/s/GPU | Total tok/s/GPU |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| C4 | 287.74 → 325.33 (+13.06%) | 61.82 → 64.67 (+4.61%) | 7,358.65 → 7,458.75 (+1.36%) |
| C16 | 135.71 → 144.60 (+6.55%) | 165.79 → 164.52 (-0.77%) | 19,727.25 → 19,617.63 (-0.56%) |
| C32 | 89.83 → 87.81 (-2.26%) | 355.57 → 361.78 (+1.75%) | 47,170.00 → 47,906.26 (+1.56%) |

<details>
<summary>ITL and TTFT (baseline → candidate)</summary>

| Comparison | Mean ITL (ms) | p90 ITL (ms) | Mean TTFT (ms) | p90 TTFT (ms) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| C4 | 2.293 → 2.209 | 3.470 → 3.054 | 379.025 → 384.964 | 930.524 → 936.523 |
| C16 | 5.267 → 5.338 | 7.364 → 6.903 | 538.874 → 538.037 | 868.419 → 1,053.297 |
| C32 | 7.937 → 7.625 | 11.125 → 11.382 | 745.069 → 681.098 | 1,347.779 → 1,254.675 |

</details>


<details>
<summary>Configuration and reproduction</summary>

Both arms use one image rebuilt from main [380c8e438](https://github.com/jiacao-amd/vllm/commit/380c8e438cc7833338bea3f06bc9e03c8bece667) (pinned when this validation started), including Python and C++.

C16/C32 use NVFP4 KV/indexer, V2 + DBO and a 32K prefill budget. Both arms include the same text-only DBO startup-guard fix (`supports_multimodal_inputs`). C4 uses FP8 KV/indexer, mono decode, an 8K prefill budget and no DBO.

Use the corresponding #4671 serving lane. Set `CONC` to the table's concurrency and `TOKENIZER` to the pinned model snapshot:

```bash
agentx profile --url http://127.0.0.1:8000 \
  --model amd/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Quark-MXFP4 \
  --tokenizer "$TOKENIZER" \
  --concurrency "$CONC" --benchmark-duration 900 \
  --tokenizer-trust-remote-code \
  --server-metrics http://127.0.0.1:8000/metrics \
  --public-dataset semianalysis_cc_traces_weka_062126
```

</details>

### GSM8K accuracy

Original scoring, all 1,319 questions per run; TP4/C16, 5-shot, temperature 0, seed 42, reasoning effort low, 4096-token output limit, and real DSpark K7 block rejection.

Repeated evaluation: **two runs per arm**, using the same model revision and serving configuration above and one image rebuilt from main `380c8e438`, including the shared DBO startup fix. Candidate: `99ec093d5` (tiles only).

| Configuration | Run 1 correct / 1319 | Run 2 correct / 1319 | Mean accuracy | Mean delta |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Baseline | 1,265 | 1,269 | 96.06% | — |
| Tiles only | 1,273 | 1,267 | 96.29% | +0.23 pp |

All four runs completed without API errors. Prefix-cache resets succeeded before every run; token-limit answers remain in the original scores.

Earlier single-pair GSM8K result: **1,274 → 1,267 correct (96.59% → 96.06%)**; invalid answers **0 → 0**.

## Details

Tile selection uses M, local N and K; `BLOCK_K` divides K. No new kernel or model interface. This follow-up changes no MiniMax TP4 tile, so the TP4 serving and GSM8K results above retain their original attribution. The new TP2 exclusion uses the existing main fallback.

AI assistance: OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

<details>
<summary>Pull Request Checklist</summary>

- [x] PR checklist used; AI assistance disclosed.
- [x] Design fit, tests, documentation and CI coverage reviewed.
- [x] Requested performance validation and model evaluation complete.
- [ ] Attribute the observed GSM8K accuracy difference.
- [ ] Hosted CI complete.

</details>
